records.title: Review of National mineral policy
details: Based on the report submitted by the committee, a draft National Mineral Policy (NMP) 2018 was uploaded on the official website of the Ministry on 10.01.2018 for seeking comments/suggestions from all stake holders. The New National Mineral Policy is yet to be finalized.

records.title: Demonstrations in JNU
details: Hon'ble Minister replied that he would definitely look into such discriminations meted out to the students and as well see to it that the responsibilities of the Chancellor or the Vice-Chancellor or the Registrar or the Dean of Students' Welfare are carried out as they ought be.

records.title: Tamil Nadu fishermen stranded in Iran
details: Mr. Naqvi will convey this to the hon. External Affairs Minister for Whatever possible action.

records.title: Facilities offered by AI to passengers
details: Air India uplifts in-flight meals from reputed caterers who also cater to other international and domestic airlines. Surprise meal checks are carried out at caterer's premises to monitor uplift of meals with regard to quality, quantity, taste, presentation and eye appeal. Periodic Hygiene Audits are also being carried out at caterer's premises to improve the quality of meals.

records.title: Clarifications on Statement RE. missing IAF AN-32 Aircraft
details: Hon'ble Minister inter-alia stated that he will provide information.

records.title: Legislation to protect the breach of privacy
details: The drafting of the Right to Privacy bill is at preliminary stage and details of the bill are yet to be finalized.

records.title: Religion-wise population Figures
details: The data will be released once it is finalized

records.title: Empowement of transgender community
details: An Inter-ministerial committee has been constituted to purse implementation of the Expert Committee's recommendation in the light of Supreme Court's judgement.

records.title: Payment and settlement system
details: The matter of inacting legislation with regard to payment and settlement system in the country, and details thereof is under consideration in Reserve Bank of India.

records.title: Licence fees for setting up of OBUs
details: At present settung up of off-shore banking units(OBUs) in India by commercial banks is not permitted. Reserve Bank of India(RBI) has reported that it is examining the various issues concerning setting up of OBUs in India and a decision in this regard is yet to be taken.

records.title: Schemes to rehabiltate sex workers
details: Advisory Committee on Child Prostitution have been set up at Central and State levels to address the issues in cooperation with NGO representatives. An amendment to the Immoral Traffic(Prevention) Act,1956 is underway for making punishment for traffickers more stringent.

records.title: Investigation of misleading advertisements by MRTPC
details: A number of unfair Trade practices Qnuiry have been considered by the MTTP Commission. These cases are being enquired into by the Commission and are pending before the Commission at various stages of consideration.

records.title: Creation of a department of border management in MHA
details: A detailed proposal for the creation of a separate Department of Border management is at present under consideration.

records.title: Expert Committee on increasing the life of currency notes
details: The recommendations of the Expert Committee on increasing the life of currency notes are under consideration in the Department of Economic Affairs

records.title: Details regarding launching of Private Trains
details: It was inter-alia stated that the contours of the project and the timelines for launching of trains services by private operators are under finalization.

records.title: Marks for Sports schemes in schools
details: It was inter-alia stated a final view is yet to be taken in the matter

records.title: AIIMS like Institutes
details: The Central team has inspected the above sites offered by Government of Tamil Nadu and have submitted its report. The report of the Committee is under consideration.

records.title: Mining projects without Environmental clearance
details: The Environmental Impact Assessment Notification, 2020 is to be finalised by Ministry of Environment, Forest & Climate Change. However, all mining projects irrespective of their type and size of mining lease area attract the provisions of EIA Notification, 2020 also.
